rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-4: ONE knob pretrain_epochs 3->6 (warm-start INIT quality), keep lr=1e-4 (the iter-3 anchor: 0.9553->0.9593). Failure mode/insight: per-scan U-Net N2I overfits its own GT-free split-view objective, so n_iter is NOT the lever (iter-2 n_iter600 DROPPED to 0.9407); the working lever was per-scan lr down to 1e-4, which PINS each per-scan fit to the warm-start init. The complementary lever per the campaign insights + sibling runs is therefore warm-start INIT QUALITY: pretrain_epochs lifted demo-n2i 0.4880->0.4957 and mayo-n2i 0.9541->0.9558. Hypothesis: a better-converged warm-start init (6 epochs) gives each pinned-at-low-lr per-scan fit a stronger anchor, lifting val above 0.9593. Wall: iter-1 (ep3,n_iter300) ran 421s; doubling pretrain epochs adds a few min only -> well under the 15min wall.
